text: Objectives Objective of the undergraduate program in E-Commerce aims to enhance students’ ability in management, communication, E-Commerce system Planning, and Analysis and Design. The program includes subjects in the areas of management, trade, finance, marketing, computer network technology, modern business and management, law, trade principles, as well as Chinese trade relations with neighboring regions. Graduates from the program will have a good employment opportunity in companies and government agencies involved in trades with China. Duration Duration of the program is 4 years with course works in the first three years, followed by a thesis project and practice. Degree Awarded A bachelor degree in economics is awarded for students who meet the requirement for graduation. Main Courses Principles of Management, Principles of Economics, E-Commerce Database Technology, E-Commerce Development Technology, E-Commerce System Analysis and Design, E-Commerce Website Construction, Electronic Payment and Network Finance, E-Commerce Logistics Management, Network Marketing and Planning, E-Commerce Laws and Regulations. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship
